case.text: I was double-charged this month but I can't say which charge it was. Please look it up and refund the extra one.
case.final_message:
I looked this up for you. Your February 2026 invoice INV-2026-0142 (Pro plan, 49.00 yuan) shows two card payments: PAY-88212 and PAY-88213, each 49.00 yuan, both marked succeeded on 2026-02-02, 41 seconds apart. No other invoice on this record shows more than one payment, so that is the only duplicate charge I can see.

I can't issue a refund. Any refund needs a person's approval before it is issued, and I can't promise a date. An operator will decide whether the extra 49.00 yuan is credited back.
